not_captured.clash-in-the-act: Still outstanding. A frame showing a sprite actually inheriting a neighbouring cell's ink needs a game with COLOURED paper behind a moving sprite. Manic Miner, Sabre Wulf and Knight Lore all fail for the same reason they appear in the entry — they use black paper and avoid the artefact by construction. Two frames were rejected during this session for appearing to show clash and not showing it on close reading.
